title: 16B primary plus one lazy secondary
before: A shape miss replaces the primary strong shape.
change: Keep the primary, consult one secondary only after primary miss; allocate the per-function secondary array on real polymorphism.
cost: One function pointer, lazy secondary storage, comparisons and additional strong shapes.

title: 16B primary plus three lazy secondaries
before: Monomorphic primary cannot retain four alternating shapes.
change: Same separated path with three secondary entries and first-empty then round-robin replacement.
cost: More secondary probes and retained shapes; primary remains16B.

title: One-layer prototype cache with global structural epoch
before: Inherited normal-data reads repeat a receiver and holder lookup.
change: On primary miss guard receiver shape and a global structural epoch, then load the current holder value.
cost: Conservative invalidation on all add_property and shape_prepare_update calls, lazy24B side records.

title: One-layer cache with watched-holder invalidation
before: Global structural invalidation discards unrelated inherited-read records.
change: Mark a holder when cached; bump the shared epoch only for structural operations on marked holders.
cost: One object bit and mutation-side condition, conservative shared epoch among watched holders.

title: Borrowed arg/local read with dynamic lookahead
before: A short arg/local load duplicates the receiver, dispatches again, then frees that temporary on an own IC hit.
change: In eight existing short-load handlers recognize an immediately following get_field_rdi and execute an exact hit without temporary receiver ownership.
cost: Every such short load tests the next opcode, even when no fusion applies.

title: Prepared borrowed-load fused opcodes
before: Dynamic lookahead adds a condition to all eight ordinary short-load handlers.
change: Prepare eight same-size fused-load opcodes only at final short-load/get_field_rdi pairs; preserve the following opcode and all offsets.
cost: Eight static C handlers and preparation/serialization work, no generated native code.

title: Borrowed arg/local read with dynamic lookahead, macro declaration order corrected

title: Prepared borrowed-load fused opcodes, macro declaration order corrected
before: Dynamic lookahead adds a condition to all eight ordinary short-load handlers.
change: Prepare eight same-size fused-load opcodes only at final short-load/get_field_rdi pairs; preserve the following opcode and all offsets.
cost: Eight static C handlers and preparation/serialization work, no generated native code.

title: Four guarded shapes share one field action
before: A conventional PIC stores a separate offset with each shape.
change: Keep16B primary and three cold strong shape guards with one shared verified offset; clear the group when the action changes.
cost: Linear secondary shape probes and conservative group clearing on a different offset.
reason: Shared-action clearing must publish all guards before releasing any strong shape; no performance data collected

title: Eight guarded shapes share one field action
before: A four-shape action group can still replace frequently at wider sites.
change: Extend only the shared-action cold guard set to seven secondaries.
cost: More retained shapes and worst-case comparisons, no per-secondary offset.

title: Own integer-result read opcode
before: An exact own-data hit rejoins a handler accepting all value types and misses.
change: Quicken after a proven exact hit to a guarded integer-result opcode; one failure restores the generic read IC before executing it.
cost: One result-tag guard and another handler; an alternating result can repeatedly specialize/deopt.

title: Own immediate-result read opcode
before: Reference-free primitive results still pass through the generic value duplication form.
change: Specialize non-reference-counted values while retaining object, class, shape and current-value guards.
cost: A result-tag range check and handler layout; all owned result/reference semantics remain.

title: Predecoded ordinary bytecode frame size
before: Each ordinary bytecode call adds/multiplies immutable var/stack/var-ref counts.
change: Prepare the immutable base frame byte size once per function; retain callee class, argument, interrupt and stack-overflow checks.
cost: One size_t per bytecode function and an extra cached metadata load; no cached closure/function value.

title: Four guarded shapes share one field action, reentrant group publication
before: A conventional PIC stores a separate offset with each shape.
change: Keep16B primary and three cold strong shape guards with one shared verified offset; clear the group when the action changes.
cost: Linear secondary shape probes and conservative group clearing on a different offset.

title: Eight guarded shapes share one field action, reentrant group publication

title: Borrowed fusion only for first argument/local
before: d03 adds lookahead to eight short-load handlers; independent SunSpider shows crypto-sha1 regression.
change: Keep identical fusion only in get_arg0/get_loc0, restore the other six original s001 handlers.
cost: Less field-read coverage, the two retained handlers still pay lookahead and native layout can change.
